observations: The brand 'AUCMA' is printed on the side of the body.
A red indicator light is glowing, suggesting the unit is powered on.
A temperature adjustment dial is visible under the handle.
The power cord is attached with a white strain relief boot.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 are identical images.
The soleplate (bottom) of the iron is not visible.
No model number or technical specification plate is visible.

risks.risk: The soleplate may be scratched, rusted, or have burnt-on fabric residue.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the soleplate.

risks.risk: The iron may not reach or maintain the correct temperature despite the light being on.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron heating up and evaporating a drop of water.

risks.risk: The specific model and wattage are unknown, affecting performance expectations.
risks.proof: A photo of the rating plate, usually found on the heel or bottom.

proof_requests: Photo of the soleplate (bottom) to check for damage.
Photo of the rating plate or sticker showing the model number and wattage.
A different angle of the iron to confirm it is the actual item in the seller's possession.
response.reason: The seller provided two identical photos that omit the most critical part of an iron (the soleplate) and the model identification plate. A valuation cannot be made without seeing the condition of the heating surface.
